question: Should assistant-message copy use a per-click Markdown/plain-text menu, a persisted default preference, or remain Markdown-only?
rationale: This is a new visible UX capability, and the implementation depends on maintainer intent for the control shape and plain-text conversion semantics.

options.title: Per-click format menu
options.body: Add a small copy-format menu with Markdown and plain-text options while preserving the current Markdown default.

options.title: Persisted default preference
options.body: Add a user preference for default copy format, which is more stateful and should only proceed if maintainers want another preference surface.

options.title: Keep Markdown-only
options.body: Decline the feature and leave the current copy action unchanged, accepting the ongoing raw-text friction.

recommendation.title: Per-click format menu
recommendation.body: Add a small copy-format menu with Markdown and plain-text options while preserving the current Markdown default.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the original copy-as-markdown behavior and already provided maintainer-facing review context on this issue.
